create_action_distribution: create an ActionDistribution from a sequence of floats or tensor representing action probabilities
sample_from_values: sample keys from a Values object using probability-weighted multinomial sampling
build_action_space: build an ActionSpace with a given number of actions and create an action distribution
train_model: train a Trainer subclass model on TrainingData with specified iterations and sample count
save_and_load_model: save a trained model to a pickle file or load a model from a pickle file
